name: Markdown
description: A WYSIWYG Markdown editor for local files inside DBX, powered by iml-editor-lite (MIT) and Tiptap 2.

versions.releaseNotes: Initial release: Typora-style WYSIWYG Markdown editor with local file support (open/save via native dialogs), outline, folder browsing, recent files, task lists, tables, and HTML export.

2.0.0: new editing core (iml-editor-lite lite-v26.4.6, MIT) with rich-text / source dual mode, verbatim saving, Callout, [TOC], WikiLink, KaTeX, Mermaid, find & replace, slash menu, and export to HTML / Word / long image. Bundled third-party license texts now ship in assets/licenses/, and the About panel reports the upstream copyright and license correctly.

zh-CN.name: Markdown 编辑器
zh-CN.description: DBX 工作台内的所见即所得 Markdown 编辑器：富文本 / 源码双模、原样保存、公式与图表、导出 HTML / Word / 长图。基于 iml-editor-lite（MIT）。
